MUNICIPAL POLICE.
C. I. D.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D.!!
Shanghai Date January 29, 1929

INTELLIGENCE REPORT.
Political

General Li Chai-sen, Chairman of the Canton Provincial
Committee, and Chief of Staff to the National Government,
arrived at Shanghai North from Nanking at 1 p.m. January 28.

The following notables left Shanghai North for Nanking
at 11 p.m. January 28:

General Chiang Kai-shek, Commander-in-Chief of the
Nationalist Armies, and President of the National
Government.

T.V.Soong, Minister of Finance.

Wong Pah Chuen, Minister of Communications.

Kung Hsiang Hsi, Minister of Labour, Industry and
Commerce.

(批：此 (copy)) — Chang Ching Liang, Chairman of the Chekiang Provincial
Committee.

Tan Yen Kai, President of the Administrative Yuan.

Chen Chao Kwan, Chief of the Naval Department of the
Ministry of War.

It is reported that General Chiang Kai-shek has succeeded
in persuading Admiral Chen Chao Kwan, Chief of the Naval
Department of the Ministry of War, to withdraw his resignation
and to return to Nanking.

CHIN

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记室
编号 I. O. D.!!
上海，日期：1929年1月29日

情报报告。
政治类

广东省政府委员会主席兼国民政府参谋长李济深将军，于1月28日下午1时从南京抵达上海北站。

以下名流于1月28日晚11时离开上海北站前往南京：

国民党军队总司令兼国民政府主席蒋介石将军。

财政部长宋子文。

交通部长黄伯群（音译）。

工商部长孔祥熙。

（批注：此件（副本））— 浙江省政府委员会主席张静良（音译）。

行政院院长谭延闿。

军政部海军署署长陈绍宽。

据报，蒋介石将军已成功说服军政部海军署署长陈绍宽海军上将撤回辞呈，并返回南京。

CHIN

MUNICIPAL POLICE.
C. I. D.
Shanghai, January 29, 1929.

INTELLIGENCE REPORT.
Military

The following munitions, brought from the Kiangnan Arsenal,
were despatched to Hangchow from the South Station at 8 p.m.
January 28:-

. 24 Mountain guns
140 "Stokes" guns
26 machine guns
1,000 rifle (approximately).
150 Mauser pistols.
200 pistols
500 casks gunpowder (approximately)
60,000 cases of ammunition of diverse calibre.

30 disabled soldiers formerly belonging to the 4th
Independent Division arrived at Shanghai from Fokien by the
s.s. Singning" at 10.30 a.m. January 28, and dispersed at
Nantao.

Two hundred and fifty members of the Special Service
Regiment, attached to the Kiangsu Bureau of Civil Affairs and
stationed in Chinkiang, were transferred on January 28 to
Fenghsien, Pootung Hinterland, to act as garrison troops
against possible communistic uprisings and banditry.

下列军火自江南制造局运来，于1月28日晚8时从南站发往杭州：-

山炮 24 门
“斯托克斯”迫击炮 140 门
机枪 26 挺
步枪约 1,000 支。
毛瑟手枪 150 支。
其他手枪 200 支
火药约 500 桶
各种口径弹药 60,000 箱。

原属独立第四师的30名伤残士兵，于1月28日上午10时30分乘“新宁”轮（s.s. Singning）从福建抵达上海，并在南市分散安置。

隶属江苏省民政厅、驻镇江的特务团250名成员，于1月28日调往奉贤及浦东腹地，担任卫戍部队，以防范可能的共产主义暴动及匪患。

MUNICIPAL POLICE.
C. I. D.
Shanghai, January 29, 1929.

INTELLIGENCE REPORT.
Labour

Unrest now exists among the wharf coolies at Nantao who are agitating for an increase of wages.

The workers, numbering about 1,000 of the Pootung Factory of the B.A.T. Co. who struck work on January 27 as a protest against the dismissal of a shroff, resumed work at 1 p.m. January 28 pending further negotiation by the Union with the management.

The strike situation in the Sun Sun Co., No. 145 Nanking Road, remains unchanged. Some 200 of the strikers held a meeting between 9 a.m. and 11 a.m. January 28, 1929, in the offices of the Fourth District Kuomintang Section, Jukong Road, Chapei. Chang Chi Shun (張志純), member of the Strike Committee, presided. The following resolutions were discussed and passed :-

1. That no striker be permitted to resume work.
2. That negotiations to resume work be discontinued if strikers demands are not acceded to.
3. That groups be organized to make representations to the Manager for the issuance of wages due to the employees.
4. That efforts be made to locate and punish severely labour traitors and running dogs.

（印：OFFICE OF COMMISSIONER OF POLICE JAN 29 1929 SHANGHAI）
pages.zh:
工部局警务处。
刑事侦缉处。
上海，1929年1月29日。

情报报告。
劳工类

目前南市码头苦力中存在不安情绪，他们正在鼓动增加工资。

英美烟草公司（B.A.T. Co.）浦东工厂约1,000名工人因抗议一名收银员被解雇，于1月27日罢工，后在工会与管理层进一步谈判期间，于1月28日下午1时复工。

南京路145号先施公司（Sun Sun Co.）的罢工局势保持不变。约200名罢工者于1929年1月28日上午9时至11时，在闸北菊康路国民党第四区党部办公室举行会议。罢工委员会委员张志纯主持了会议。讨论并通过了以下决议：-

1. 不允许任何罢工者复工。
2. 如果罢工者的要求得不到满足，则停止关于复工的谈判。
3. 组织小组向经理交涉，要求发放拖欠员工的工资。
4. 设法查明并严惩工贼及走狗。

（印章：警务处处长办公室 1929年1月29日 上海）

TRANSLATION OF EXTRACTS FROM SHANGHAI POLICE INTELLIGENCE REPORT.

January 29, 1930.

The communistic troops of Chu Te have invaded the southern
and western parts of Kiangsi Province. Their advance guard is
at Woe Lin Hsien, in the western part of Kiangsi. General Ho
Chien, Commander-in-Chief of the Bandit Suppression Force in
Kiangsi, and General Ching Hang Ting, the Deputy Commander, have
decided to attack Ching Kang Shan, the headquarters of the
communistic troops.

About 300 members of the Union of Restaurant Employees
(Cantonese) held a meeting at 2 p.m. yesterday at No. 41 Yi Teh
Lee, Paoshan Road, Chapei. Liang Yeng Yi, who presided,
declared that the restaurant keepers had refused to accept the
demands submitted by the employees.

It was resolved 1) To refer the matter to the Social
Bureau, 2) To organise a Strike Committee, 3) To organise
protection groups, 4) To issue a strike order on February 10
if satisfaction be not secured.

The meeting terminated at 3.30 p.m.

A quantity of cartridges, 24 mountain guns, 26 quick
firing guns etc. were sent to Hangchow at 8 p.m. yesterday
from the South Station.

（批：C.P. Information / Recd）
（印：OFFICE OF COMMISSIONER / JAN 30 1930 / SHANGHAI）
（批：Duty）

上海警察情报报告摘录译文。

1930年1月29日。

朱德的共产主义部队已侵入江西省南部和西部地区。其先头部队位于江西西部的沃林县（音译）。江西剿匪总指挥何键将军及副总指挥金汉鼎将军已决定进攻共产主义部队总部井冈山。

昨天下午2时，约300名（广东籍）酒楼员工工会成员在闸北宝山路怡德里41号举行会议。主持人梁永义（音译）宣布，酒楼老板拒绝接受员工提出的要求。

会议决议：1) 将此案提交社会局处理，2) 组织罢工委员会，3) 组织纠察队，4) 若未能获得满意结果，则于2月10日发布罢工令。

会议于下午3时30分结束。

昨晚8时，一批子弹、24门山炮、26门速射炮等军火从南站发往杭州。

（批注：中共情报 / 已收悉）
（印章：警务处处长办公室 / 1930年1月30日 / 上海）
（批注：值班）
